unchanged_budget.normalization: per coordinate max(1, reference RMS); RMS bound applies to every coordinate
unchanged_budget.rationale: Prospective engineering limits informed by the existing roughly 1e-5 FP32 discrepancy; not formal roundoff bounds or a claim that strict parity passes. Common-state limits are tighter because recurrence cannot accumulate error. State scale stays one for bounded GRU states; the RMS floor prevents unstable relative errors near zero. WP limits constrain task-level drift, per sequence as well as per-target means to prevent cancellation. These diagnostics use training data only and do not establish generalization or release fitness.

scope: One previously failed TRAIN sequence only; no optimizer, other groups, validation or gate changes
